title: Grafana SQL migrations: append-only, mirrored in migration_ids.txt
answers: How do I add a new database migration in Grafana?
Why is there a migration_ids.txt test failure after adding a migration?
Can I edit or reorder an existing migration?
How to add an index via the migrator framework?
body: New migrations must be appended at the end of the relevant *_mig.go function (e.g. addApiKeyMigrations) via mg.AddMigration with a unique, descriptive name — never edit or reorder existing migration entries, since their IDs/SQL are already applied on production installs. Every new mg.AddMigration call must have its exact name string appended to pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/testdata/migration_ids.txt in the same position, or the migration-ids test fails. For adding an index specifically, use NewAddIndexMigration(table, &Index{Cols: [...]}) which works across MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQLite and includes a built-in index-name existence check.
applies: Any PR adding/modifying a Grafana SQL migration in pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations

search: Grafana SQL migrations must be appended only to the end of *_mig.go functions and never reordered, with each new mg.AddMigration call name mirrored in migration_ids.txt. Existing migration IDs and SQL are already deployed to production and cannot be modified. For index additions, use NewAddIndexMigration() which provides cross-database compatibility and built-in index-name checks. This rule applies when adding or modifying migrations in pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/ and enforced by the migration-ids test. Paths: pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/apikey_mig.go (and similar *_mig.go files), pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/testdata/migration_ids.txt.
